name: Kitaibaraki (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kitaibaraki city emblem in white: a stylised angular device of interlocking strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kitaibaraki, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 August 1956.

features.role: Kitaibaraki city emblem — a stylised angular device of interlocking strokes
